facts.statement: SOE Podcast 83, posted April 13, 2010, lists Free Realms' 1st birthday among its topics.
facts.quote: Listen in on Fan Faire news, plans for EverQuest birthday events, and Free Realms 1st birthday.

facts.statement: Free Realms' 1st birthday celebration was set to begin April 29, 2010, with new in-game events and prizes to follow.
facts.quote: is about to kick off its 1st birthday celebration on April 29th . New in-game events and prizes will soon be available

article_summaries.title: SOE Podcast 83 - EQ Birthday Events
article_summaries.summary: This is a Ten Ton Hammer post announcing SOE Podcast 83, a multi-game show covering Fan Faire, EverQuest birthday events and Free Realms' first birthday. The page itself gives no Free Realms details; it only names the topic. The show notes and download links are on the official SOE Podcast site, which is not in this capture.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Celebrates 1yr Anniversary with Events and New Music Video
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news item (posted April 22, 2010) announcing Free Realms' first birthday celebration starting April 29, 2010, with in-game events and prizes to come. It also reports a new music video for the theme song "It's Your World", with a behind-the-scenes feature on the Free Realms website and the full video on Aol.com. The article gives no event details, prize lists or mechanics.
